page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores with 2 threads per core, driven by an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 9 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across multiple domains. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to its strong performance in specialized tasks. In Geekbench testing, the instance achieved a multi-core score of 19030.0 and a software compilation score of 45495.0. Memory performance is notable, with cached read-only small block bandwidth reaching 4111.32 GB/sec and large block write bandwidth at 95.0 GB/sec. It also demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds of 353.0 tokens/sec for small 135M LLM models, alongside strong performance for medium 7B models at 30.87 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c7i-flex family offers a balanced compute-to-memory profile designed to optimize resource utilization without the premium of fully dedicated, non-flex compute instances. However, workloads requiring local NVMe storage or direct GPU acceleration will face tradeoffs, as this instance lacks local disks and GPUs. The 9 Gbps baseline network bandwidth may also limit highly distributed clustering workloads compared to higher-tier instances.

This instance is well-suited for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from high-speed DDR5 memory and advanced CPU vector instructions. Appropriate use cases include software compilation, web serving (achieving 72.85 GB/sec in static web serving benchmarks), database operations, and CPU-based machine learning inference for small to medium models.
description: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.12xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of DDR5 memory at 5 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, but lacks local storage and dedicated GPUs. Operating on the Nitro hypervisor, it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 9 Gbps. Benchmarks show strong performance, including a Passmark CPU score of 65056.32, a Redis SET rate of 62.18 million operations per second, and top-tier text generation speeds of 353.0 tokens/sec for small LLM models. This instance is highly efficient for compute-heavy tasks, making it suitable for software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
